title: Moroccan Yellow Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and comforting vegan stew from the flavors of Morocco, featuring yellow lentils and caramelized vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook, stirring occasionally, for 20-25 minutes or until caramelized.
Add the chopped carrots and bell peppers; cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the tagine spice mix and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the lentils and broth; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
